class.name: ResourceLocalizationCatalog
class.brief_description: A catalog of localized resource paths.

method.name: add_translation_remaps
method.description: Adds the entries of [param remaps], a [Dictionary] in the form of the project setting [code]internationalization/locale/translation_remaps[/code]: each key is a resource path, each value a [PackedStringArray] of [code]"localized_path:locale"[/code]. No file is opened: the expected type of each key comes from its file when it is requested (see [method get_expected_type]).

method.name: get_expected_type
method.description: Returns the resource type expected for [param key]: the type set with [method set_expected_type], else the resource type of the file [param key] (resolved on each call, not stored). Returns an empty [StringName] if the key is unknown or neither is available.

method.name: get_localized_path
method.description: Returns the path of [param key] in [param locale], or an empty [String] if the resource is not localized for that locale.

method.name: set_expected_type
method.description: Sets the resource type expected for [param key] (a class name such as [code]"Texture2D"[/code]). Adds the key if needed.

method.name: set_localized_path
method.description: Sets the path of [param key] in [param locale]. Adds the key and the locale if needed. An empty [param path] removes the localization for that locale.

method.name: to_translation_remaps
method.description: Returns the catalog as a [Dictionary] in the form of the project setting [code]internationalization/locale/translation_remaps[/code]. Keys without a localized path are left out. Loads all locales.
